exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Giving (to someone of higher status): Noun を さしあげる".

options.text: 名詞 を さしあげる
A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! 名詞 を さしあげる matches "Giving (to someone of higher status): Noun を さしあげる".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is 名詞 を さしあげる.
exercises.explanation: Polite way to give something to a superior; humble form of あげる.
